card.architecture: AnimeSharpV2 (RealPLKSR, fixed 2x) - a feed-forward super-resolution CNN, no diffusion
card.summary: Upscale anime, illustration and other 2D art through AnimeSharpV2's 'Sharp' RealPLKSR network. One deterministic pass: it resolves the lines and flats that are already there and invents nothing, so the drawing survives exactly as drawn. The network is fixed at 2x; Scale below 2 fits the 2x result down to the size you asked for.
use_cases: enlarge anime / illustration / cel art without softening the line work
clean up compression artifacts and jaggies on a 2D source
finish an image whose content is already correct and only needs resolution
card.nsfw_capable: yes - no content model, it only resolves pixels
card.commercial_use: NON-COMMERCIAL: AnimeSharpV2 is CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Use the Photo upscaler (CC-BY-4.0) for commercial work.
card.pick_when: The source is drawn - anime, manga, illustration, cel art. Use Photo for photographic sources; the anime net will smear film grain and skin texture it was never trained on.

prompt.guidance: This editor takes no prompt. Anything typed in the instruction box is ignored - there is no text encoder in the graph.
prompt.instructions: Send a source image and set Scale. No prompt, no seed, no steps: the same source always produces the same output.
do: Leave Scale at 2 for the network's native, sharpest result
dont: Expect it to add detail that isn't in the source - it resolves, it does not invent

negative.note: Feed-forward SR network; there is no conditioning of any kind.

speed.note: A single convolutional pass. No sampling loop, ~30 MB of weights, tiled internally by ComfyUI.
speed.measured_note: Not yet benchmarked on this box.

ui_help.note: Send an image and pick a Scale. No prompt is used. Output is deterministic - re-running gives the identical image.
ui_help.good_for: enlarging drawn art without losing the lines

edit_use_cases: upscale a drawn / anime image, preserving the composition exactly
